executive_assessment.text: The profile reports 2018/19 yields fell over 60% versus 2018 (maize 78%, wheat 61%, sorghum 93%).
The profile map ranks 42% of agricultural areas in five named districts among Lesotho's most drought-prone.
The profile rates early warning low and notes weak institutional coordination and no protocol.
